method: Historical mechanical steelhead replay using St. Joseph River at Niles, MI USGS 04101500 daily mean discharge, St. Joseph River at Niles, MI — measured water temperature USGS 04101500 daily mean measured water temperature, and three dynamic daylight segments built from UTC archive hours converted with historical local-time rules, using radiation, cloud cover, and precipitation. The read is scoped to Measured conditions describe the Niles mainstem and cannot be extrapolated to the harbor, each tailwater, South Bend, Mishawaka, or Twin Branch. It validates scoring behavior and copy, not catch rates.
